_comment: RQ3 for Jessica at 0.6 m, after the unit swap of 6 October: the pair kept reads about 571 mm at a tape distance of 600 mm, so expected_range_mm is the pair mean of the sensors' own readings at tape 600 (570.25 with unit 3 in A and unit 1 in B). square_offset_mm is B minus A on the squared board (+2.5 with unit 3 in A and unit 1 in B). Angles stop at 12 degrees per side because at 0.6 m the 27 degree view stays on a 60 cm board up to about 12.3 degrees; beyond that the sensors see past its edge. Run: python -m rig session --guided --port COM7 --config configs/rq3_jessica_0p6.json --out data
name: rq3-jessica-0p6
